Cross-checks welcome — graph6 for P₄ is `CU`. Verifier + writeup going to [link to gitlab.com — details withheld] shortly.

The part I like most: the result survives even if you reject my reading. 38 and 39 are consecutive and identically worded, so "eigenvalue" must mean the same matrix in both — and by Graham–Pollak a tree's distance matrix has exactly one positive eigenvalue, which makes 39 false instead.
